# A downstream node sees success only once held work commits

A node holding a claim does not emit its success while the claim is still
provisional. The subscriber outside the holding subgraph runs after the commit,
so it acts on results that can no longer be rolled back.

## The template

The `co-holder` calls an endpoint that holds every request open until released,
so the provisional moment is observable.

```yaml
name: held-commit-demo
version: "1"
nodes:
  - type: acquirer
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    claim_producers:
      - name: claim-producer-filesystem
        selector: data
        intent: rw
        alias: ds
    error_types:
      "acquire/unavailable": {action: give_up}
    attributes:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          v: {type: integer, default: 1}

  - type: co-holder
    executor: verifier-http
    holds:
      ds: {from: acquirer}
    subscribes:
      - node: acquirer
        type: terminal/success
        force_upstream_refresh: false
    attributes:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          url: {type: string, default: "http://gate:8000/hold"}

  - type: watcher
    kind: attribute_passthrough
    subscribes:
      - node: acquirer
        type: terminal/success
        force_upstream_refresh: false
    attributes:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          v: {type: integer, default: 1}
```

`watcher` is not a member of the holding subgraph.

## While the held work is in flight

```bash
curl -sS "$BASE/v1/observability/node-runs?instance_id=$IID"
curl -sS "$BASE/v1/observability/events?instance_id=$IID&limit=500"
```

The acquirer's node-run reads state `held`. It has emitted no success signal.
The watcher has no node-run at all.

## After the commit

Release the endpoint. The claim resolves with a single
`claim_resolution.commit`. The acquirer emits exactly one `terminal/success`, at
the next sequence number after that commit, and the watcher's `work_started`
follows it.

A downstream node acts on held results only once they are durable.
